title: AgentMarket
tagline: AI API marketplace for autonomous agents to discover, use, and pay for APIs.
description: AgentMarket is an autonomous AI service marketplace where agents can discover capabilities, choose the right service for a goal, pay per request, and receive results without traditional API keys or subscriptions. The project combines a natural-language Agent Playground with real Hedera x402 payments and live The Graph Agent0 data. For paid execution, the agent automatically handles a 0.002 HBAR payment through x402 and Blocky402 on Hedera Testnet before executing the PixelForge service. AgentScout uses live Agent0 data through The Graph to discover and rank ERC-8004 agents based on capabilities, MCP support, x402 support, feedback, and validation data.
how_its_made: AgentMarket was built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and SCSS Modules. The autonomous execution flow is implemented in the Next.js backend, where the agent analyzes a natural-language goal, discovers available services, ranks capabilities, and executes the selected provider. Hedera x402 is integrated using @x402/core, @x402/fetch, @x402/hedera, and @x402/next. The PixelForge endpoint is protected by x402 and uses Blocky402 as the Hedera Testnet facilitator. The agent signs HBAR payments from a Hedera ECDSA account and the resulting settlement is decoded and displayed in the UI. For agent discovery, AgentScout queries The Graph Gateway using the Agent0 subgraph and ranks live ERC-8004 agent data using capability, MCP, x402, feedback, and validation signals. The application is deployed on Vercel.
auto_summary: A Next.js app lets an agent discover services, rank agents from The Graph data, and pay x402-gated Hedera endpoints per request.
